reviews.review:
This is a top down shooter to start off.

Graphics: The graphics are an odd one because for a game like this, top down they are actually pretty decent and are very well presented, which weirdly makes the game decent just on that note, but we know graphics do not make a game!

Audio: The audio is again fairly odd for this one, but some how it all works as one which is awesome from the odd gun sounds, so the weird mic hissing noise sounding like a radio but at the same time it does not. 

Controls: The controls are super super easy to use and get used too.  It's pick up and master and you got this. 

Game and everything else after: The game has a decent amount of ranks you can get through, always levelling after max (12) and different type of prestige resetting system and getting a special tag, go 12 more and reset and getting a better badge, kinda like Titanfalls system or cods system of ranking up. No real reason for it other then a badge icon really.

Sadly the campaign is very very short and you will often want to download other creations to play to play through which adds a lot more fun to the game for play time, but even they are short too. So this game is short at best. 

I guess it comes down to play-ability with friends pushing harder difficulties with them on how much you want to rinse and repeat. Do not get me wrong, it is a fun game to play.

There are some great difficulties to choose from and if you want to push then insane/ hoard... You will run out of ammo before the first door and why this is made is beyond me even thinking how it's possible. 

The game is coop which is awesome, seriously awesome, you'll see alone in this game is boring and does require some friends to get more fun from it. 
Also the game is free to play so how can you pass this up....

Would I recommend? Yes why not it's an easy few hours of fun for free and a tiny download.
Best Free game i ever played, if they put a price on it, i wouldn't hesitate to buy.
